d: Short, jet black hair with thin crimson streaks is styled in messy bangs over the forehead. The eyes are narrow and sharp with a golden-yellow shade, set on a youthful face with a smug expression. The build is lean, wearing a white military dress jacket with gold filigree, red tasseled epaulettes, and a white collared shirt with a gold tie. A black, mechanical armored piece with red glowing accents and gold trim covers the left side of the face and eye.
